motion.name: hover-quiet
motion.purpose: Hover color and border shifts only; no transforms.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one solid action; pill, cyan, uppercase tracked.
components.css: .btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; border-radius:9999px; background:var(--color-signal); color:var(--color-floor); padding:12px 20px; font-size:0.875rem; font-weight:600; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:0.18em; transition:background-color 150ms ease; } .btn-primary:hover { background:var(--color-signal-bright); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary links styled as quiet pills.
components.css: .btn-ghost { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; border-radius:9999px; border:1px solid var(--color-hairline-strong); background:var(--color-surface); color:var(--color-ink); padding:12px 20px; font-size:0.875rem; font-weight:600; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:0.18em; transition:border-color 150ms ease,color 150ms ease; } .btn-ghost:hover { border-color:var(--color-hairline-bright); color:var(--color-ink-bright); }

components.name: Feature Card
components.description: Tonal surface card for capability lists.
components.html:
MQTT users and basic ACLs

Create, disable and rotate MQTT credentials.
components.css: .card-feature { border-radius:1.5rem; border:1px solid var(--color-hairline); background:var(--color-surface); padding:24px; transition:border-color 150ms ease,background-color 150ms ease; } .card-feature:hover { border-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--color-signal-bright) 30%,transparent); background:var(--color-surface-strong); }

components.name: Stack Chip
components.css: .chip-stack { border-radius:9999px; border:1px solid var(--color-hairline); background:var(--color-surface-chip); padding:4px 12px; font-family:'JetBrains Mono Variable',monospace; font-size:0.75rem; color:var(--color-signal-pale); }

components.name: Command Block
components.description: Quickstart command line inside a rounded dark block.
components.css: .cmd-block { display:block; border-radius:1rem; border:1px solid var(--color-hairline); background:var(--color-surface-code); padding:12px 16px; font-family:'JetBrains Mono Variable',monospace; font-size:0.875rem; color:var(--color-signal-pale); overflow-x:auto; }

narrative.overview: MCM's site is a dark telemetry console: a calm operations room where the state of one broker is read before anything is changed. Depth comes from tonal layers of translucent surfaces over a deep radial field — no shadows, no drama. Cyan is the signal color; JetBrains Mono carries everything technical; Manrope carries the human layer. The console never sells: it reports.
keyCharacteristics: Dark tonal console with translucent surfaces and zero shadows
Cyan as the single signal accent; amber strictly for caution
Uppercase wide-tracked eyebrows label every section like a readout
Pill geometry for interactive and meta elements; rounded-3xl containers
Mono for stack, commands and numerals — the technical layer is typographically distinct

rules.name: The Signal Rule
rules.body: Cyan marks signal and action; its largest legal field is a 10% tint. Amber appears only in the caution panel.

rules.name: The Technical Layer Rule
rules.body: Anything a terminal could say is JetBrains Mono; anything a person says in prose is Manrope.

dos: Keep every section under a cyan uppercase eyebrow
State status honestly where it is claimed
Separate surfaces with hairlines and tonal tints, never shadows
donts: Don't add a second accent color
Don't use gradients other than the fixed body radial field
Don't animate beyond hover color/border transitions
Don't nest translucent cards inside translucent cards
